messages:
alex: 3pm quick cut-window check — short status update. Did: merged two backports (gpu-runtime, infra). Blockers: flaky integ test on canary; one cherrypick blocked by schema change. Today: watching canary and will promote if stable.

devin: seeing a spike in pending queue earlier, looks like autoscaler didn't spin up fast enough. digging.

alex: @devin which metric spiked — tail-latency or pending_count?

devin: pending_count hit 72 around 14:05, then dropped. logs show an OOM on pod r-gtx-04; suspect a bad model snapshot. I'll escalate in eng-sre.

sarah: cherrypick #1123 is blocked by schema v2.0 change — I can rebase & fix but need API compatibility sign-off. @kevin can you take a look?

kevin: happy to review, will do a pass in ~30m. quick FYI: local perf for quantized-ggml shows ~8% regression on long sequences.

alex: noted. for canary I'm running the prompt-suite (smoke + perf). if it stays green for 20m I'll promote the non-quantized variant.

ci-bot: Canary job #558 completed — 3 failures: reranker-integ (timeout), kv-cache-flaky, perf-regression-quantized. Logs: https://ci.redwood/558

sarah: reranker-integ failure looks like a timeout on a single shard, probably flaky. I'll re-run that one.

devin: opened ENGINFRA-321 for autoscaler oddness, assigned to @mira. pinging eng-infra channel.

alex: small ask — please hold non-critical merges into the train for the next hour while I watch the promote :eyes:

kevin: :thumbsup: will hold merges that touch runtime and routing.

maria: rerun started (triggered by sarah) — will update when it finishes (~10m).

sarah: rerun passed, reranker-integ is green now.

alex: thanks. canary still flags perf-regression for quantized. @kevin can you paste the perf snippet?

kevin: snippet:
```
latency p95 baseline: 120ms
latency p95 quantized: 130ms
seq_len=4096, payload=1
```

alex: ok — decision: keep quantized variant out of default rollout for now. promoting non-quantized.

ci-bot: Promotion triggered: rollout non-quantized -> 30% traffic (job #559).

maria: left a note on the release board about holding quantized.

alex: thanks all — I'll post final status in ~30m. if anything urgent, ping here. /end
